title: PR #34: feat(l1): connect wallet node RPC and multi-process E2E
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Scope
- Connect atc-wallet TcpNodeClient to the canonical atc-node JSON-RPC runtime.
- Route submit_transaction through signature verification, mempool admission, block production, state transition and durable storage.
- Add wallet -> atc-node process E2E covering transaction identity, block inclusion and state balance.
- Add CI gates for the wallet/node process test and canonical multi-process network E2E.

## Verification target
GitHub Actions must provide actual green cargo test evidence before this L1 path is called CI-verified.
